summary: Implemented the window title feature in the repository without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and admits Tuple[ControlType, str] in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the escape format ESC ] 0 ; title BEL and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool, buffering the control only when is_terminal is true; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a legacy branch calling term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_console.py::test_set_window_title (skipped on Windows), test_control.py::test_control_title, and test_windows_renderer.py::test_control_set_window_title (Windows only, via the module skip). Not verified: tests were not run and Black formatting was not checked.
